name: alias-resolution
description: A declared alias resolves to its page, and stays salient across the rolling window without being required a second time.

pages.title: Dana Reed (advisor)
pages.body: Dana Reed advises on pricing and packaging.

pages.title: Northwind Traders
pages.body: Northwind Traders is the reseller covering the EU.

turns.text: Any update from Dana on the pricing memo?
turns.note: "Dana" is a declared alias, not the title and not the slug tail — alias arm 0.90 plus the newest-turn boost.

turns.text: Dana sent it on Tuesday; Northwind Traders has it now.
turns.note: Two arms in one turn: the alias again, and an exact title.

turns.text: Thanks, what did Northwind say about the renewal?
turns.note: Northwind is what the turn is about; Dana is still in the window, so re-offering her is defensible but not required.
